keyPoints: Rekha-khand ko scale se napte hain; do binduon ke beech ki sabse chhoti doori hi us rekha-khand ki lambai hoti hai.
Kon do kirnon ke milne se banta hai — nyun kon (90 se chhota), samkon (90), adhik kon (90 se bada, 180 se chhota), aur saral kon (180).
Tribhuj bhujaon se: samabahu (teenon barabar), samadvibahu (do barabar), vishamabahu (koi barabar nahi); konon se: nyun-kon, sam-kon, adhik-kon tribhuj.
Chaturbhuj chaar bhujaon ka band aakaar hai — varg, aayat, samachaturbhuj (rhombus), samantar chaturbhuj, samalamb (trapezium) iske prakar hain.
Bahubhuj (polygon) teen ya zyada bhujaon ka band aakaar hai — panchbhuj, shatbhuj; jitni bhujaen, utne sheersh.
Vritt me kendra se paridhi tak ki doori trijya hai; chaaron taraf ghoom kar wapas aane wali rekha paridhi hai — parkar ka ek sir kendra par, doosra paridhi par hota hai.
Aam galti: samachaturbhuj ko varg samajhna — varg me kon bhi 90 ke hote hain, jabki samachaturbhuj me sirf bhujaen barabar hoti hain.
